title: sync.job.requested
description: The sync-orchestrator asks a supplier connector to run a sync for one account (schedule-driven). The connector fetches from the supplier and emits discovered/price-changed events. Topic: sa.sync.job, key: account_id.

supplier_code.description: Supplier short code the connector is registered under, e.g. 'brain'

account_id.description: Account (ULID) to sync — a supplier can have several with different terms

credentials_ref.description: Vault path to the account's credentials (a pointer, never the secret itself)

settlement_currency.description: ISO-4217 code the account settles in, e.g. 'USD'

kind.description: What to sync: the product catalog, this account's offers (prices/stock), or both

mode.description: How much to sync: 'full' walks the whole catalog; 'delta' fetches only items changed since the connector's last watermark (falls back to full on the first run). Absent means 'full'.

sync_job_id.description: ULID correlating every event produced by this sync run

requested_at.description: When the sync was requested (UTC, ISO 8601)
